name: County Line U-pick
description: County Line U-pick grows Strawberries, Raspberries, and Pumpkins in Saint Clairsville, OH. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
